authority: user explicitly requested fixed 512x512 stride256 native top-left lattice and full 151-ROI source-only scan before ProbNet
scope: source-only native ROI window census; not formal cohort or target approval
window_order: patient_id, ROI filename, crop_y, crop_x ascending
boundary_policy: only complete in-bounds lattice windows; no shifted edge windows
raw_asset_identity: each RGB/tissue/nuclei read is SHA verified against the audited native asset bytes before decoding

qualification.tumor_rule: exact ID1 present, retain existing frozen cheap-source definition; not a new relaxation to fine tumor children
qualification.failure_reasons: all independent cheap failures retained per window, including duplicate and excluded windows
qualification.historical_training_background_filter: record fraction only; not an additional gate in user-specified cheap-source rules

deduplication.decoded_hash_header: canonical JSON shape/dtype uint8, NUL delimiter, contiguous decoded bytes; RGB converted to RGB, masks unmodified uint8
deduplication.overlap_graph: all positive-overlap in-bounds lattice neighbors; overlap pixels and window IDs recorded; one independent unit per patient

invalid_old_export_limit: never mark unreadable historical PNG as pixel verified or repair/overwrite it; retain file SHA and error; readable components must match native coordinates before conservative aliasing
patient_selection: eventually first fully four-target-qualified and independently reviewed source in fixed source order; never by H&E, model readout, actual-J proximity or multiple crops per patient
nuclei_provenance: historical CellViT-derived pseudo-labels; original checkpoint SHA unresolved, original JSON and raster kept unchanged
